# Alex Liu — mini-ghost.dev

> Senior Front-End Developer based in Taiwan, specializing in Vue and Nuxt.
> Author of "為你寫的 Vue Components" (ISBN 9786264143011).
> Creator of Vorms, an open-source Vue form-handling library.
> Technical blog covers Vue/Nuxt internals, source-code deep-dives, and front-end architecture.
